lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: NIX! WE HAVE TO HIDE THIS CASE RIGHT NOW [beat] OR THE WHOLE SCHOOL IS GOING TO BLOW UP IN OUR FACES!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Riku, why are you carrying a locked steel briefcase [beat] and why does it have the Principal's private seal on the lid?

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: I found it sitting in the teacher's lounge, Nix! [beat] I thought it was the new VR prototype, but it’s making a weird ticking sound!

lines.speaker: kamal
lines.text: Nix, why are you two huddled in the corner like guilty raccoons [beat] instead of finishing your calculus equations?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: It’s just my science project, Mr. Kamal! [beat] It's a very sensitive vacuum chamber that needs to stay away from the light!

lines.speaker: kamal
lines.text: That is the strangest science project I've ever seen, [beat] and I'm pretty sure I heard a digital beep coming from your backpack.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Look at these two losers trying to hide a treasure chest [beat] move aside before I show you what a real scientist does!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Bruno, back off! [beat] This thing is dangerous and you have no idea what you’re messing with, you absolute meathead!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Oh, I'm shaking in my boots! [beat] Give it here or I'll tell the Principal you're planning some kind of prank in the hallways!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: The timer just skipped a minute, Nix! [beat] If we don't open this thing now, the security team is going to hunt us down!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Fine, Riku! [beat] Use the gaming pick you carry around and let's see what’s inside before we all get expelled!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The lock clicked open, revealing something that wasn't a bomb, [beat] but was definitely much worse for Nix's future.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Wait... [beat] why are there photos of every single teacher in here with red circles around their faces?
